title: A
wikitext:
A group of players from the clan [[Hangar 18]] disjoined and started another clan because they thought there was too many players in Hangar 18.

When thinking of a name they came across "Tippex", because it erases everything. But later they decided on A, very simple. It has no special meaning, just A.
